description: Trustpilot is an online review platform for businesses and consumers. Its products include business review-management APIs and a Data Solutions product for accessing business profiles and review data.
summary: Trustpilot exposes three documented REST API surfaces on trustpilot.com-owned hosts: the core `api.trustpilot.com/v1` APIs, a separate invitations API on `invitations-api.trustpilot.com/v1`, and the Data Solutions API on `datasolutions.trustpilot.com/v1`; authentication is via `apikey` headers for public/data products and OAuth bearer tokens for private business APIs, sometimes plus `x-business-user-id`.
